title: Remedies for Covered Concerns Under the Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Standard.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a remedy is authorized only for a covered concern. The inspection of that concern determined it covered. A plan that requires no inspection needs no inspection: a Chip Repair Guarantee concern is remedied by a chip credit when the network replaces that windshield, where the plan credits the chip repair toward a windshield replacement. Otherwise the remedy is a network rework at any network center, targeted at the plan's rework target business days, with a courtesy ride within the plan's courtesy ride miles; and sensors the rework disturbs are recalibrated at no charge where the plan provides recalibration on rework. When the customer is more than the plan's outside-shop distance miles from the nearest network center (and that distance figure is above zero), the remedy may instead be an outside-shop repair, authorized before the work is done. A concern whose network reworks ended not resolved the plan's escalation number of times (counted as the reworks on the concern completed not resolved) receives no further rework authorization at the desk and goes to the regional warranty manager.

**Retired clause.** The clause "when the target exceeds the plan's rework target days above which the courtesy rental is offered, the network pays a courtesy rental of up to the plan's courtesy rental days days" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the rework courtesy rental days the network pays on a covered network rework.

## Condition for authorizing a remedy

The inspection of that concern determined it covered. The evidence is the company's inspection record for the same coverage and the same concern number; the customer's description of the concern does not stand in for it.

## Remedies at a glance

| Remedy | When it applies |
|---|---|
| Chip credit | A Chip Repair Guarantee concern, where the plan credits the chip repair toward a windshield replacement, when the network replaces that windshield |
| Network rework | Otherwise, at any network center, targeted at the plan's rework target business days, with a courtesy ride within the plan's courtesy ride miles |
| Outside-shop repair | Instead of a network rework, when the customer is more than the plan's outside-shop distance miles from the nearest network center and that figure is above zero; authorized before the work is done |

Each authorization is one remedy attempt on the concern, numbered in order, and records whether the rework disturbs sensors that must be recalibrated. Each completed network rework or outside-shop repair is recorded as resolved or not resolved.

## Escalation count

The count is the network reworks and outside-shop repairs on that concern completed not resolved, over the life of the concern. Hypothetical cases under a plan whose escalation figure is 2: one completion not resolved, the escalation point is not reached; two completions not resolved, the concern receives no further rework authorization at the desk and goes to the regional warranty manager.
